title: Platform
two_factor_text: The platform area can change every restaurant. Set up two-factor sign-in first.

restaurants.name: Name
restaurants.owner_hint: A new owner gets an e-mail to choose a password. An existing user is simply added as owner.
restaurants.counts: {{menus}} menus · {{items}} items · {{branches}} branches · {{views_30d}} views in 30 days
restaurants.payment_saved: Payment recorded. The paid period was extended.
restaurants.resend_welcome_hint: New owners get the welcome e-mail with a set-password link (valid 7 days). Owners who have signed in before get a normal "reset your password" e-mail instead. Earlier links stop working.
restaurants.welcome_sent: Password e-mail sent to the owner.
restaurants.suspend_hint: The menu shows “unavailable” and the team can't make changes. The owner sees the reason.
restaurants.delete_confirm: Delete {{name}}? It can be restored for 30 days, then it is removed for good.
restaurants.approval_hint: The owner confirmed their e-mail. Approve to put the menu online, or reject with a reason (the owner gets it by e-mail and the account is removed).
restaurants.approved: Approved. The owner was told by e-mail.
restaurants.reject_hint: The owner gets this reason by e-mail. The account and restaurant are removed and the menu address is free again.

payments.hint: Payments recorded by hand. Each extends the restaurant's paid period.

plans.hint: What restaurants pay for and what they can use.
plans.name: Name
plans.limits: Limits (empty = unlimited). Only photos and branches are counted on the standard plans.
plans.replaced: Old plan: its restaurants move to {{name}} when their paid time ends.

themes.hint: Ready-made looks restaurants can start from.
themes.name: Name

activity.hint: Changes on the platform and in restaurants.
activity.subject: Subject

settings.name: Platform name
settings.general_hint: The platform name, contact address, domain and legal texts shown to restaurants and guests.

share.title: Link preview
share.hint: The picture WhatsApp, Telegram, Facebook and X show when someone shares a menu that has no banner. Menus with a banner show their banner. JPG, PNG or WebP, at least 600 × 315; it is cropped to 1200 × 630.
share.saved: Link preview saved. Menus will show it from now on.
share.failed: That picture couldn't be used. Try a JPG or PNG of at least 600 × 315.

mail.title: Email (SMTP)
mail.using_platform: All platform e-mails (invitations, password resets, e-mail checks) are sent through this server.
mail.using_env: Nothing saved here yet: e-mails use the server's .env settings ({{host}}). Save a server below to use it instead.
mail.password_saved: A password is saved and is never shown. Leave the field empty to keep it, or type a new one.
mail.password_hint: Stored encrypted. It is never shown again after saving.
mail.test_failed: The test e-mail to {{email}} could not be sent.
mail.reset_done: E-mails now use the server's .env settings.
mail.test_invalid: Type a valid e-mail address, like name@example.com.
mail.test_limit: Too many test e-mails. Wait a minute, then try again (5 per minute).

w.inactive_hint: No menu views and no edits for 14 days or more.
w.none_inactive: Every restaurant was active in the last 14 days.

warn.cron: Cron has not run in the last 10 minutes. Check the cron line in cPanel.
warn.disk: Less than 10% disk space is free.
warn.failed: Some emails failed to send. Check the mail settings.
warn.queue: Many emails are waiting in the queue.
warn.errors: There were errors today. Check storage/logs.
warn.backup: Backups need attention: the last one failed or none succeeded in 26 hours. Open Backups.

mail.title: Email the owner of {{name}}
mail.intro: Edit the message, then send it. It is sent to the restaurant's owners and logged.
mail.subject: Subject
mail.failed: The email could not be sent.
mail.expiring_body:
Hello,

Your plan for {{name}} ends in {{count}} days. Renew it to keep your menu online for your guests.

Reply to this email if you have any questions.
mail.inactive_subject: Can we help with your {{name}} menu?
mail.inactive_body:
Hello,

We noticed your menu for {{name}} has been quiet lately. If something is not working or you need help setting it up, just reply to this email.

Thank you.
mail.expiring_body_one:
Hello,

Your plan for {{name}} ends in {{count}} day. Renew it to keep your menu online for your guests.

Reply to this email if you have any questions.

signup.title: Sign-up
signup.hint: Restaurants can create their own account at /auth/sign-up, confirm their e-mail and start on a plan.
signup.signup_open_hint: When off, the sign-up page shows “Registration is closed”.
signup.plan_hint: Every self-registered restaurant starts on this plan, with no end date. Edit its limits under Plans.
signup.signup_approval_hint: New restaurants wait in Restaurants → “Pending sign-up” until you approve them. Their menu is not public until then.
signup.signup_notify: E-mail me about every new sign-up
signup.signup_notify_hint: Sent to every Super Admin when an owner confirms their e-mail.
signup.turnstile_enabled_hint: Off by default. Sign-up also has a hidden honeypot field and rate limits, so it works without it.
signup.turnstile_help: Create a free widget at dash.cloudflare.com → Turnstile and paste both keys. The secret is stored encrypted and never shown again.
signup.domains_hint: Disposable e-mail services, one domain per line. Sign-ups and e-mail changes with these domains are refused.

logo.title: E-mail logo
logo.hint: Shown at the top of every platform e-mail (sign-up, welcome, invitations). PNG, JPEG or WebP; resized to at most 480 × 120.
logo.none: No logo yet: e-mails show the platform name.
logo.failed: The logo could not be saved. Use a PNG, JPEG or WebP picture under 5 MB.

landing.title: Landing page
landing.hint: The public home page that turns restaurant owners into sign-ups. Plans and prices come from Plans; the platform name from the settings above.
landing.headline: Headline
landing.headline_default: Your restaurant menu on every phone, in seconds
landing.subline_default: Guests scan a QR code and see your dishes, photos and prices. Change a price and every phone shows it at once. No app to install, free to start.
landing.text_hint: Leave empty to use the default text (shown in grey), which is translated when more languages are added.
landing.color_hint: Buttons and highlights use it; text shades are adjusted automatically so they stay readable in light and dark mode.
landing.whatsapp_hint: Used for “Contact us on WhatsApp” on the paid plans and the “Upgrade on WhatsApp” hint in the admin. Empty: the support e-mail is used.
landing.testimonials_hint: Only real quotes from real customers, with their permission. The section stays hidden while this list is empty.

invoices.hint: Every recorded payment gets an invoice with the next number. Invoices are never changed or deleted: void a wrong one and issue a new one.
invoices.void_hint: The invoice stays in the list, marked VOID with your reason. Its number is never used again.
invoices.reissue: Issue a new invoice for the same payment
invoices.voided_reissued: Invoice voided and a new one issued.

billing.title: Billing
billing.hint: Shown on every new invoice. Invoices already issued keep the details they were issued with.
billing.prefix_hint: Next invoice: {{example}}. Numbers run on without gaps and start again at 0001 each year.
billing.tax_hint: VAT is shown as included in the amount paid; 0 hides the VAT line.
billing.invoice_email_hint: Each new invoice is e-mailed to the restaurant's owners with the PDF attached.

crm.title: Notes and follow-up
crm.tags_hint: Labels for your own use, such as VIP, At risk or Hot lead. Restaurants never see them.
crm.delete_confirm: Delete the tag {{name}}? It is removed from every restaurant.

messages.hint: E-mails to restaurant owners: news, offers and reminders. They go out a few per minute through the e-mail queue.
messages.rate_hint: How many campaign e-mails the queue sends each minute. Keep it below your mail provider's limit.
messages.compose_hint: Write the e-mail, choose who gets it, check the preview and send yourself a test first.
messages.subject: Subject
messages.body_hint: Placeholders are filled in for each restaurant. Blank lines start a new paragraph.
messages.unsubscribe_note: Owners who unsubscribed from news are left out. Every e-mail has an unsubscribe link.
messages.preview_sample: With sample details (no owner matches yet).
messages.confirm_text: It can't be stopped once it starts. Sending takes a few minutes; you can follow it here.
messages.picked: Only the {{count}} restaurants picked in the restaurants list (other filters still apply).
messages.picked_one: Only the {{count}} restaurant picked in the restaurants list (other filters still apply).
messages.picked_other: Only the {{count}} restaurants picked in the restaurants list (other filters still apply).
messages.picked_clear: Send to all matching restaurants instead

backups.hint: The database and every uploaded photo, zipped every night at 02:30 and kept outside the public folder.
backups.started: Backup started. It appears here when it's done (usually within a few minutes).
backups.delete_confirm: Delete this backup? The off-site copy is deleted too.
backups.none: No backups yet. Press “Back up now” to make the first one.
backups.restore_note: Restoring replaces all data, so there is no button for it: follow “Restoring a backup” in docs/deploy.md.
backups.confirm_hint: A backup contains every restaurant's data. Enter your password or a code from your authenticator app; the download link works for 5 minutes.
backups.settings_hint: Older backups are thinned out to the newest one of each day, week and month.
backups.backup_s3_enabled: Copy each backup to S3-compatible storage
backups.offsite_hint: Works with Backblaze B2, Cloudflare R2, AWS S3 and others. The secret key is stored encrypted and never shown again.

search.title: Search the platform
search.hint: Restaurants, owners, invoices, payments and tags.

legal.draft: Draft — have a lawyer review before relying on it.
legal.format: Shown on /terms and /privacy. Format: the first line "Last updated: …"; "## " starts a section (listed in the contents); "- " starts a list item (two spaces before it for a sub-item); **bold**; a blank line starts a new paragraph. HTML is shown as text.
legal.reset_desc: Your text is replaced by the default text and saved at once. This can't be undone.

ins.hint: Numbers are rebuilt every hour from data the app already keeps. Click any number to see the restaurants behind it.
ins.not_built: Numbers not built yet — run php artisan platform:aggregate
ins.overview_hint: Compared with the previous period of the same length.
ins.funnel: Activation (restaurants that signed up in this period)
ins.cohorts_hint: Restaurants by sign-up month: how many are still active and paying today.
ins.health_hint: Score 0–100: setup 30, edits 20, menu views 30, plan 20. Inactive = no views, no edits and no team sign-in in 30 days.
ins.engagement_hint: From restaurant teams' sign-ins and changes, and guests' menu views.
ins.usage_hint: Restaurants using each feature now. Plan limits reached are upgrade chances.
ins.team_hint: Team members of all restaurants. 'Active' means signed in or made a change. Only each person's latest sign-in is kept, counted from when sign-ins started being recorded.
